Cyprus

Grade B

The government seeks full participation. On 13 November, the president said the technical prerequisites had been met and no member state had reacted negatively.

President of Cyprus · statement of 13 November Cyprus government · Ioannides statement

The Commission has positively assessed preparations and is preparing a briefing for ministers on the application of Schengen rules on the island.

Greece

Grade B

Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis publicly expressed hope for accession on 1 July 2027, at the start of Greece's Council presidency.

Greek Prime Minister · Nicosia transcript
Collective position

MED9 Mediterranean group

Grade B

Greece, Spain, Italy, Cyprus, Malta, Portugal, Slovenia, France and Croatia welcomed progress on the dossier. The declaration did not give a common target date.

MED9 group · Split declaration
Positions require confirmation

Austria, the Netherlands and Poland

Grade C

Media commentary suggests these countries may be cautious. The monitoring has found no public commitment to vote against accession and no confirmed veto.

Kathimerini / KNEWS · column on Schengen readiness
Sovereign Base Areas

United Kingdom

Grade B / C

London and the EU reaffirmed their intention to complete implementation of the bases protocol. Arrangements for checks at Pergamos and Strovilia remain unresolved.

UK government · summit statement EU–UK Joint Committee · 10 November Politis · checks at two crossings
Diplomatic context

Türkiye

Grade A / C

Ankara influences settlement negotiations on the island. Türkiye does not take part in the EU Council vote. Fidan opposed linking the Cyprus issue to customs union modernisation.

Turkish Foreign Ministry · Fidan–Fitto meeting Anadolu · Fidan's position
Green Line

Cypriot communities and the UN

Grade A

Community leaders agreed on two new crossings under UN mediation. Arrangements for recording entries and exits still need to be determined separately.

UN · statement on new crossings EUR-Lex · Regulation (EU) 2024/1356
